reason: Conversation 1 correctly explained dE as a door-not-locked error, zeroed in on the king-size duvet caught in the seal, had the homeowner confirm with a towels test that the machine is fine, and gave sensible no-part advice (launderette, wash the cover, air it) tailored to the visitors deadline. Conversation 2 gave up with 'cause not confirmed' and sent the homeowner to an engineer even after being told a duvet corner was squashed in the seal and the door was springing back — an unnecessary escalation that misses the obvious no-fault diagnosis.
